notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Zombies.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five untapped Zombies you control, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
